# Kenco to Open 30K-square-foot Innovation Lab for Hands-On, Supply Chain OEM Testing and Demonstration

Published at August 18th 2026, 9:00 AM EDT via Business Wire

 Leading 3PL’s new test environment – debuting September 2026 – to prioritize smart automation and unlock what is possible for logistics 

 Kenco, a leading third-party logistics (3PL) provider, today announced its plans to open a new, expanded Innovation Lab. The 30,000-square-foot Chattanooga, Tenn., facility will replace and build upon the legacy of Kenco’s previous 10,000-square-foot facility. Additional space enables the organization to test and demo more supply chain solutions and accommodate larger, more complex technologies. The new lab will also encourage greater collaboration with the Chattanooga technology community. 

Construction of Kenco's new Innovation Lab, which will serve as a collaborative space for developing, testing and demonstrating innovative supply chain solutions.

 A ribbon cutting event is planned for Sept. 10 at the lab, located at 4885 Claude Ramsey Parkway, Suite 105, in Chattanooga.
